short_scenes.caption: Together again.
short_scenes.narration: Leo ran into his parents' arms. Mia kissed his forehead. John held them both, and didn't let go.

short_scenes.caption: Enemies… or friends?
short_scenes.narration: Days later, Zor came to the village. Not with a club. With his tribe, asking to learn fire.

short_scenes.caption: Peace, at last.
short_scenes.narration: That night, two tribes sat around one fire. For the first time, there was peace.

short_scenes.caption: Then the cold came.
short_scenes.narration: But far in the north, the sky was turning white. The great cold was coming.
